name: False Spider
source:
[Horror] x [Mystery] x [Magic]

Kuroyo Mayonaka, a high school student who gained magical powers from the "Great Witch" Circe—a figure who vanished during the medieval [Witch Trials]—sets out to find someone important to him, someone who got swept up in [a certain urban legend]. 
All the hidden truths behind these tales are waiting for the player to uncover…

[Translated from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3140060/False_Spider/]steam[/url]]
translation:
[Horror] x [Mystery] x [Magic]高中生黑代真中从在中世纪【魔女审判】中消失的人物“大魔女”喀耳刻那里获得了魔力，他开始寻找对他来说很重要的人，一个被卷入【某个都市传说】的人。
这些故事背后隐藏的一切真相等待着玩家去揭开……

[翻译自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3140060/False_Spider/]steam[/url]]
